<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/schedule/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Writes a new object, or the entry's own, at the entry's path, with the fields that the request gives and the entry's own for the rest. A file that has the content does not change. An entry that osapi did not deploy is not found. The entry stays in its directory: an interval does not change with update.
